final_serial_median.deadline_proof: An accepted DELAY_RESP sets child_state=0. A subsequent accepted estimate requires valid SYNC, FOLLOW_UP and DELAY_RESP left-RX frames; codec validates total length 36 or44 bytes, accepts two bytes per valid word, and emits at most one event per frame. Thus >=3*18=54 clocks separate accepted estimates.
